method.label: Compare fifth powers in polar form

annotationRationale: The derivation uses the common modulus, multiplies arguments by five, and evaluates special-angle cosines to compare real parts.
sourceMethod: Followed the official polar-form solution with arguments reduced modulo 2π. Evaluated the real parts explicitly to clarify the comparison.

review.mathCheck: All choices have modulus 2. Their fifth powers have real parts \(-32,16\sqrt3,16\sqrt2,-16,0\), respectively. Every listed argument and reduction is correct, so B uniquely maximizes the real part and agrees with the key.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 13, page 7. It uses the same polar fifth powers and reduced arguments, replacing the final angle comparison with explicit cosine values.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation states De Moivre's formula and checks every choice. Its assessed polar-power skill and supporting special-angle calculations are appropriate for AMC 12.
